notable.description: EAST BLOCK - Proposal to construct 5 residential rental towers (Building 2 - 24 storey, Building 3A - 25 storey, Building 3B - 26 storey, Building 4 - 14 storey, & Building 5 -17), 781 residential units (including 85 affordable units), commercial on levels P1, ground floor, & level 2, 5 levels of underground parking, and interior alterations to existing heritage buildings.  571-581 BLOOR ST W, 742-782 BATHURST ST (EXCLUDING 756 & 758 BATHURST), 26-34 LENNOX ST, 601-603 MARKHAM ST.
Proposal to construct 13 storey building with 159 rental units, ground floor commercial use and 2 levels of underground parking
Proposed conversion of former Loretto College building into 36 residential units with 13 additional townhomes on site.bin 2067
New mixed use building containing 273 residential dwelling units and 898 square metres of commercial space with below grade parking.

Proposal for soil remediation/shoring  including vertical drilling, corner bracing and horizontal struts for future mixed use development - Mirvish Village RedevelopmentAddress includes 571, 581, 585, 593, 595, and 597 Bloor St W, 738, 740, 742, 744, 746, 754, and 760 Bathurst St, 28 lennox St, 581, 583, 585, 587, 589, 591, 593, 595, 597, 599, 601 and 603 Markahm St.
Proposed renovation of ground, second and third floors of existing college, including one elevator, three lifts and 163m2 glass enclosure - "Royal St George College".

Proposal to construct a three-storey mixed-use building containing assembly (Estonian Centre) and office uses, which attaches to, retains, and re-uses the existing three-storey commercial building at 11 Madison Avenue.Do not issue untill 24 100310 ALT 00 issued

Renovation to part of floors 14, 12 and 11, student rooms, kitchens and washrooms. Renovation includes new mechanical, plumbing, electrical services and architectural partitions and finishes. occupant load will remain as per pre-renovation. Existing fire alarm system to remain.

The purpose of Spadina Easier Access project is to built the barrier free vertical transportation between each level of the station. The design includes a new passaenger elevator in each platform (Northbound and Southbound), and mofication of the existing escalators and staircases layout

Proposed addition to extend the TTC Spadina LRT Station platform and interior alterations to the concourse/LRT level of the Spadina station.  The proposed modification/addition to the existing station platform will be entirely underground and will encroach in the adjacent Paul Martel Park.  Note a separate permit has been applied for the portion of propsed tunnel located withing 316 Bloor St W.

open.description: The proposal involves a 3-storey addition to the existing 2-storey building, resulting in a 5-storey mixed-use building. The development would retain medical office uses in the basement and ground floor, introduce commercial/office space on the second floor, and provide 15 residential units on floors three to five. The proposed building would contain approximately 920 m² of medical office space, 460 m² of commercial/office space, and 1,380 m² of residential space, for a total gross floor area of 2,760 m² (4.72 FSI).
Draft Plan of Standard Condominium to create 339 residential units and 1 retail unit within a 34-storey building.
Lift the hold ('H') application for By-law 410-2024.
Site Plan Approval for a 11-storey residential building with 64 dwelling units, including the retention of part of the heritage building at 171 Lowther Avenue.
Site Plan Approval for a 25-storey building with a mix of rental replacement units (33 units) and condominium ownership units, totalling 253 units.

Zoning By-law Amendment application was appealed to Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT Case No. OLT-24-000316). On April 29, 2025, OLT issued a partial order approving a 25-storey residential building (including 33 replacement rental units), final order pending fulfilment of outstanding conditions.
Proposal for a 30-storey building with retail units at grade along Bloor Street West. Overall, the proposal will introduce 472 residential units and 798 square metres of retail gross floor area.
Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment application to permit a 30-storey mixed-use building, containing 472 dwelling units and 798 square metres of non-residential gross floor area.

Zoning By-law Amendment application was appealed to Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT Case No. OLT-23-000532). On April 30, 2025, OLT issued a partial order approving a 25-storey mixed-use building with partial heritage retention, containing 186 dwelling units, non-residential uses include replacement 952 square metres of church space and 1,276 square metres of community/commercial uses.OLT Final order pending fulfilment of outstanding conditions.
Site Plan application to permit a 25-storey mixed use building containing 211 dwelling units and 1,950 square metres of non-residential GFA, including retail, community, and congregation space.

Site Plan Approval for a 36-storey mixed-use building containing 431 residential dwelling units (including 24 rental dwelling replacement units), retail at-grade and in the concourse levels and 2 levels of office space. The site includes a TTC entrance to Spadina Station, as well as 470 square metres of office space and two kiosk areas on the ground floor to be conveyed to the City to be used by Indigenous non-profit organization(s).

Site Plan Approval for a 37-storey mixed-use building atop an 8-storey base building, having a non-residential gross floor area of 627.9 square metres and a residential gross floor area of 31,231.27 square metres.  A total of 366 residential units are proposed.
Draft Plan of Subdivision for 1 development block.
Zoning By-law amendment to permit a 36-storey mixed-use building, containing 345 dwelling units and 250 square metres of non-residential gross floor area.

Zoning By-law Amendment application for a 35-storey mixed-use building, containing 422 dwelling units and 8,200 square metres of non-residential gross floor area. The site includes a TTC entrance to Spadina Station, as well as 470 square metres of office space and two kiosk areas on the ground floor to be conveyed to the City to be used by Indigenous non-profit organization(s).
Site Plan application for a 36-storey mixed use building including at grade commercial space and 499 residential units.
